---
name: reading-instructions
description: Apply when implementing or changing the client-only Markdown Reading micro app.
applyTo: "app/reading/**,docs/reading/**"
---

Read `docs/reading/README.md`, `Architecture.md`, `Testing.md`, and `Decisions.md` before editing. Keep files in browser memory only unless the feature scope is explicitly changed. Validate Markdown files at runtime, use `react-markdown` with `remark-gfm`, keep browser APIs in client code, and preserve rendered/raw, copy, download, clear, and print behavior. Update the Reading documentation whenever implementation changes.
